items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-11-10
items.q: I knew Russ Morgan's drummer, Jack Sadock, very well.

ctx.x: band, but they were a little inconsistent, depending, you know, if you caught him on a good night. That's probably a good night. I thought it was a good night evidently. But I mean, it was, it was

a hell of a band. That's, but it was the closest thing to, to, to, to, uh, Ellington that I ever heard. You knew Ben Pollock, huh? I'd met Ben Pollock. I didn't know him personally. I've, I've, I've, I've, I've I've, I know that, I've, I've met him several times. I never knew Ben personally. I knew Gene Krupa, I knew Gene personally. Did you like the way Ben Pollock played? Yeah. He had, he was a, he was a, he had a different style of most, he was a, he was a, he was a great brush player. He used to play brushes…
Two of them? I love anyone.
